meta.review_notes: Full privacy policy text was inaccessible due to anti-bot protection on H&M's website. Analysis is based on the App Store privacy nutrition label, cookie policy snippets, and secondary web sources.

app.name: H&M
app.description: Explore the latest styles in fashion, home and beauty with the H&M app. Discover inspiring collections and intuitive features that simplify the shopping experience — from instant search to real-time order updates.

verdict.one_liner: H&M shares your shopping behaviour and device identifiers with advertising partners for cross-app tracking, but offers opt-out controls and a privacy portal for managing your data.
verdict.summary: H&M's App Store privacy label reveals that your purchases, search history, device identifiers, and usage data may be used to track you across apps and websites owned by other companies. The app also collects your contact info and financial information linked to your identity. On the positive side, H&M provides a 'My Privacy Portal' where you can exercise data rights, offers a 'Do Not Sell or Share My Personal Data' option, and respects iOS device tracking opt-outs. Location-based services are strictly opt-in.
verdict.recommendation_reason: If you are concerned about behavioural tracking, cross-app ad targeting, and data sharing with major advertising platforms, consider whether the convenience of the H&M app is worth the data trade-off, or use the website with stricter cookie controls instead.

red.title: Cross-app tracking for ads
red.plain_english: H&M's App Store label shows that your purchases, search history, identifiers, and usage data may be used to track you across apps and websites owned by other companies.

red.title: Data shared with major ad platforms
red.plain_english: H&M shares your personal identifiers and activity data with advertising partners such as Facebook, Instagram, Google, TikTok, and Snapchat for personalised advertising.

red.title: Device identifiers used for advertising
red.plain_english: H&M collects device identifiers and may share encrypted email addresses or device IDs with advertising partners to target and measure ads.

red.title: Financial info linked to your identity
red.plain_english: The app collects financial information and links it to your identity, which is standard for shopping apps but increases risk if data is breached.

red.title: Data may be processed outside your region
red.plain_english: H&M's cookie settings note that in some cases your data may be processed outside the EU or EEA, which could mean weaker data protection laws apply.

green.title: Multiple opt-out options available
green.plain_english: H&M offers a 'Do Not Sell or Share My Personal Data' form, recognises browser opt-out preference signals, and respects iOS tracking permission settings.

green.title: Privacy portal for data rights
green.plain_english: H&M provides a 'My Privacy Portal' where you can view your online interactions and exercise rights like access, deletion, and correction of your data.

green.title: Location data is strictly opt-in
green.plain_english: H&M only processes your location data within the app if you actively turn on location-based services in your device settings.

green.title: User content not linked to identity
green.plain_english: Photos and other user content you upload are collected but are not linked to your identity according to the App Store privacy label.

categories.label: Camera & Microphone
categories.plain_english: The app lets you snap or upload photos for visual search. Camera access is on-demand and optional, not used in the background.
categories.detail: The app's description mentions a 'Visual discovery' feature that lets you snap or upload images for style suggestions. The App Store privacy label lists 'User Content' as collected but not linked to identity. There is no mention of microphone access.
categories.policy_excerpt: Visual discovery: Snap or upload images for style suggestions.

categories.label: Location & GPS
categories.plain_english: Location data is only processed if you turn on location-based services in your device settings.
categories.detail: Secondary sources indicate H&M only processes location data within mobile apps if the user turns on location-based services. It is not mentioned as being required for core functionality.
categories.policy_excerpt: Location data — processed within mobile apps only if you turn on location-based services.

categories.label: Contacts & Phonebook
categories.plain_english: There is no evidence that the H&M app accesses your contacts or phonebook.
categories.detail: The App Store privacy label does not list contacts or address book data. No secondary sources mention contact access.

categories.label: Storage & File Access
categories.plain_english: You can upload images for visual search, but this is user-initiated and the content is not linked to your identity.
categories.detail: The App Store privacy label lists 'User Content' as collected but not linked to identity. This likely refers to photos uploaded for visual search. Access is on-demand and optional.
categories.policy_excerpt: User Content — Data Not Linked to You

categories.label: Data Sharing with 3rd Parties
categories.plain_english: H&M shares your personal identifiers and activity data with advertising partners and may process data outside the EU/EEA.
categories.detail: Secondary sources confirm H&M shares encrypted email addresses or device IDs with advertising partners such as Facebook, Instagram, Google, TikTok, and Snapchat. Under US privacy laws this may be considered a 'sale' or 'sharing' of personal data. Data may be processed outside the EU/EEA. However, users can opt out via a 'Do Not Sell or Share My Personal Data' form.
categories.policy_excerpt: H&M may share personal identifiers (such as an encrypted email address or device ID) and internet/activity data with advertising partners.
concerns: Data shared with major ad platforms

May be classified as 'sale' of personal data under US laws

categories.label: Account & Identity Data
categories.plain_english: You must provide contact and financial information to create an account and make purchases, and this data is linked to your identity.
categories.detail: The App Store privacy label lists Contact Info and Financial Info as collected and linked to identity. This is standard for a shopping app requiring delivery and payment.
categories.policy_excerpt: Contact Info, Financial Info — Data Linked to You

categories.label: Behavioural & Ad Tracking
categories.plain_english: H&M uses your purchases, search history, and usage data to track you across other apps and websites for personalised advertising.
categories.detail: The App Store privacy label explicitly lists Purchases, Search History, Identifiers, Usage Data, and Diagnostics as 'Data Used to Track You' across apps and websites owned by other companies. Secondary sources confirm personalised advertising across websites, apps, and social media platforms.
categories.policy_excerpt: Data Used to Track You: Purchases, Search History, Identifiers, Usage Data, Diagnostics
concerns: Search and purchase history used for ads

categories.detail: The App Store age rating is 4+. No specific COPPA or GDPR-K compliance language was found in the accessible policy snippets. The app is a general shopping app without child-directed features.
concerns: No specific child data safeguards described

categories.plain_english: H&M logs your browsing patterns and device information to deliver personalised content and advertising.
categories.detail: The App Store privacy label lists Usage Data and Search History as collected. Cookie policy snippets mention collecting 'information about user, browsing patterns and device' for analytics and personalised advertising.
categories.policy_excerpt: We collect information about user, browsing patterns and device.
concerns: Browsing patterns collected for analytics and ads

categories.label: Device Info & Fingerprinting
categories.plain_english: H&M collects device identifiers and may share them with advertising partners to target and measure ads.
categories.detail: The App Store privacy label lists 'Identifiers' as both data used to track you across other companies' apps and data linked to you. Secondary sources confirm device IDs and encrypted emails are shared with advertising partners for targeting.
categories.policy_excerpt: Identifiers — Data Used to Track You; Identifiers — Data Linked to You
concerns: Device identifiers shared with ad partners

categories.label: Health & Biometric Data
categories.plain_english: There is no evidence that H&M collects health or biometric data.
categories.detail: The App Store privacy label does not list health or fitness data. No secondary sources mention health or biometric collection.

categories.label: Financial & Payment Data
categories.plain_english: Financial information is collected and linked to your identity when you make purchases, which is standard for a shopping app.
categories.detail: The App Store privacy label lists 'Financial Info' as collected and linked to identity. This is standard for processing payments and refunds in a shopping app. No details on whether card data is stored or tokenised were found in available sources.
categories.policy_excerpt: Financial Info — Data Linked to You

categories.label: Data Deletion & User Rights
